# Documentation updates

## Summary
Update all related documentation to reflect weapon leveling: GDD sections 4.4/4.5, README, code comments, and any relevant wiki entries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: GDD section 4.4 (power-ups/weapons) documents weapon leveling: per-weapon levels, diminishing returns, temporary vs permanent leveling.
- AC2: GDD section 4.5 (minerals, hold, choice) documents weapon level-up mineral choice options.
- AC3: Code comments in weaponLevels.ts, Player.ts, CombatCoreScene.ts explain the level resolution system.
- AC4: README.md references the weapon leveling feature and its demonstration gym.
- AC5: All new types (WeaponUpgradeSpec, WeaponLevelStats) have JSDoc comments.
- AC6: The weapon-leveling gym has an in-game help overlay following the full-catalogue help pattern.

## Key Files
- docs/Game Design Document.md -- sections 4.4 and 4.5
- src/utils/weaponLevels.ts -- WeaponUpgradeSpec JSDoc
- src/entities/Player.ts -- level state JSDoc
- src/scenes/core/CombatCoreScene.ts -- level-resolved firing JSDoc
- README.md -- feature reference

## Dependencies
- None (can be done at any time, but best after implementation)

## Deliverables
- Updated GDD
- Updated README
- JSDoc comments on all new/modified types
